themes_detail.label: Air quality crisis
themes_detail.summary: Air quality complaints spiked 1500% this week (4 complaints vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks), suggesting a localized environmental event or pollution source that emerged very recently and requires urgent investigation.
evidence: 4 air quality complaints filed this week vs. 0.2 average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 8.66)
Represents 1500% spike from baseline, highest statistical deviation in dataset
No prior pattern of air quality complaints in district suggests new or acute condition
reporting_angles: Identify the source: industrial facility, traffic pattern change, construction, or weather event causing spike
Interview residents about health impacts and contact EPA/NYCDEC for air monitoring data

themes_detail.label: Homeless encampments surge
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints jumped 414% last week (9 complaints vs. 1.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks), marking the sharpest increase in homelessness-related complaints and signaling a potential crisis in street homelessness.
evidence: 9 encampment complaints last week vs. 1.8 weekly average over 8-week baseline (z-score: 4.64, up 414%)
Second-highest statistical spike in entire dataset
Pattern shows sustained elevation, not one-time anomaly
reporting_angles: Map encampment locations; interview nearby residents and business owners about safety/sanitation concerns
Follow up with NYC Department of Social Services on outreach and shelter availability in Belmont/East Tremont

themes_detail.label: Electrical infrastructure problems
themes_detail.summary: Electrical complaints surged 50% two weeks ago (25 complaints vs. 16.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks), suggesting potential grid instability or aging wiring infrastructure that could pose safety risks if unaddressed.
evidence: 25 electrical complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 16.6 weekly average (z-score: 3.58, up 50%)
Aligns with CB budget request for 'Other capital budget request for DEP' suggesting systemic infrastructure neglect
Pattern could indicate transformer failures, wiring degradation, or aging electrical systems in aging buildings
reporting_angles: Request Con Edison incident reports and outage data for the district during spike period
Investigate whether spike correlates with specific blocks or neighborhoods; interview residents about power disruptions

themes_detail.label: Maintenance neglect accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Maintenance and facility complaints tripled this week (12 complaints vs. 4.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks), indicating sharp deterioration in public building upkeep and suggesting deferred maintenance becoming acute.
evidence: 12 maintenance/facility complaints this week vs. 4.1 weekly average (z-score: 3.12, up 191%)
Aligns with repeated CB budget request to 'Renovate, upgrade or provide new community board facilities'
Suggests backlog of deferred maintenance finally becoming critical
reporting_angles: Identify which public facilities (schools, parks, libraries, community centers) are generating complaints
Cross-reference with DOB alteration permits (188 filed) to see if private property maintenance is also stalled

themes_detail.label: Street noise uptick
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints jumped 91% last week (11 complaints vs. 5.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks), though residential noise declined 32% simultaneously, suggesting noise source shifted from apartments to streets and possibly related to construction or traffic.
evidence: 11 street/sidewalk noise complaints last week vs. 5.8 weekly average (z-score: 3.36, up 91%)
Concurrent 32% drop in residential noise complaints suggests shift in noise sources rather than overall increase
73 active DOB permits (alterations + new buildings) suggest construction activity may be driving street noise
reporting_angles: Map street noise complaints against active construction sites; identify which projects lack adequate noise mitigation
Interview residents about noise sources (delivery trucks, street vendors, construction) and timing of disturbances
